profile.campus: Data4 MIL01 campus, Cornaredo, Milan (217 MW / 20 ha campus total, distinct from the separate MIL02 site in Vittuone)

source.basis: Operator campus page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: This building, tagged DC10, is one of eight mapped structures on Data4 Italia MIL01 campus at Via Monzoro 101-105 in Cornaredo, a suburb of Milan, Italy. Its numbering is the highest of the plain DC-prefixed buildings in this cluster, consistent with Data4 own October 2018 statement that it had banked land on the campus for up to seven additional buildings beyond the three then operational, suggesting DC10 represents one of the later phases of that long-term expansion plan, though the exact construction or opening date could not be confirmed from any source reached this session. Data4, styled DATA4, is a European data center developer and operator founded in 2006 and headquartered in Paris, France, which its own 2019 published materials describe as controlled by AXA, the French insurance and asset-management group, though the specific AXA entity and any co-investors could not be independently confirmed this session. Data4 own site describes a six-country European footprint spanning France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece, totaling roughly ten campuses, 1.5 gigawatts of capacity, and 165,000 square meters of IT space group-wide. Data4 has operated in Italy since 2012, developing the Cornaredo campus in progressive phases according to the company own Italian-language press materials, with a fourth-generation facility of roughly 2,000 square meters and 3 megawatts of IT power to a Tier 4 design target formally inaugurated at a June 2019 campus event. Data4 current Milan-area location page describes the Cornaredo site, referred to as MIL01, as a 217 megawatt, 20 hectare campus, distinct from a separate second Milan-area site in Vittuone known as MIL02. No Data4 source reviewed breaks the 217 megawatt campus figure down by individual building, so no capacity or square footage figure specific to DC10 alone is asserted here, and no tenant is named.
profile.capacity_note: Campus level total published, 170 MW and 20 hectares, not broken down per building, so no per building MW or square footage figure is recorded.
